findings.title: Stats page shows a failed request as "No harvests in this range" with no error or retry
findings.steps: Sign in. Make GET /api/stats/harvests return 500 with an HTML body (browser_route). Open Stats from the nav, or change the From date.
findings.expected: An error message saying the stats could not be loaded, with a Retry button. The same state whether the page is opened directly or through a link.
findings.actual: The page shows the empty state "No harvests in this range – Pick a different date range, or log a harvest". The error only shows up in the console. The page never reads `error` from useApiFetch and has no retry.
findings.evidence: With the 500 mocked, main text was 'From / To / No harvests in this range / Pick a different date range...'. Same result after changing From to 2026-02-01.

findings.title: Invalid date range (From after To) shows as an empty result instead of the server's message
findings.steps: Open /stats?from=2026-12-01&to=2026-01-01, or pick a From date later than To.
findings.expected: The validation message "The From date must be on or before the To date." appears next to the fields.
findings.actual: The API returns 422 and the page shows "No harvests in this range".
findings.evidence: The inverted-range URL rendered the empty state. The 422 detail never appears.

findings.title: Clearing a date field silently falls back to the current-year bound, which can produce a 422 shown as empty
findings.steps: Open /stats?to=2025-06-01 (there is data in Aug 2025). Clear the From field.
findings.expected: Either refuse the blank value with a reason, or treat blank From as 'no lower bound' and show 2025 data.
findings.actual: The page drops the from param. The backend then defaults from to 2026-01-01, which is after the To date, answers 422, and the page shows "No harvests in this range". The From field stays blank and nothing explains why.
findings.evidence: With /stats?to=2025-06-01 and From cleared, main text showed only the empty state.

findings.title: Stats request has no timeout: navigating to Stats while the API hangs freezes on the previous page
findings.steps: Make /api/stats/harvests hang (route that never responds). On the dashboard, click Stats in the nav and wait 13 s.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s and the page shows an error with Retry.
findings.actual: Nothing happens. The app stays on the Dashboard with no loading indicator or error, because the top-level awaited useFetch blocks navigation and has no timeout. The same applies when a date change hangs: 'Loading stats…' stays forever.
findings.evidence: 13 s after clicking Stats with the hang route, the page text was still the Dashboard.

findings.title: No error state means no retry after the server recovers without changing dates
findings.steps: Make the stats API fail, open /stats, then remove the failure.
findings.expected: A Retry control reloads the data.
findings.actual: The only way to recover is to change a date or reload the page. The page keeps saying there are no harvests.
findings.evidence: Follows from the missing error and refresh handling in stats.vue. The page only destructures data and status.
